items.question: What amount is simple interest calculated on each period?
items.evidence_quote: simple interest is calculated only on your original money

items.question: What makes compound interest grow faster than simple interest over time?
items.evidence_quote: Compound interest earns money on your original money and on the money your money has already earned.

items.question: At the same positive rate and starting principal, why does the compound-interest balance pull farther ahead over repeated periods?
items.evidence_quote: Each year's interest is calculated on an increasingly larger balance.
